minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a height special permit for a rebuilt 25 Pearl Street garage and renewed an expired lot permit at 41 Country Road.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals held two remote hearings. It granted a special permit for a 15-foot-high replacement garage at 25 Pearl Street. It then granted a new special permit, reduced frontage, for a buildable lot at 41 Country Road after the earlier permit expired. Both permits carried the standard conditions.

Grant special permit at 41 Country Road as a continuation of the October permit, with two-year limit.

Country Road special permit granted with standard conditions and a two-year lapse.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for a replacement garage at 25 Pearl Street, with height not to exceed 15 feet.
The Pearl Street permit carries standard conditions: it must be recorded at the registry of deeds and lapses in two years unless construction starts.
The board granted a new special permit for a buildable lot at 41 Country Road, as a continuation of the October permit, with a two-year limit.
The Country Road permit carries standard conditions and a two-year lapse.
The chair said he would look into a complaint about the Oliva property and report back.

why_it_matters: Both decisions let owners build or rebuild on their lots, and each permit lapses after two years if work does not begin.
Neighbors of the two properties can check the recorded permit conditions at the registry of deeds; the meeting did not state when the Oliva complaint would be addressed.
